trigger: Competitive latent pool v0.2.1 passed dev after v0.1 collapse repair.
lesson: Do not diagnose multi-slot collapse from the maximum off-diagonal slot cosine alone. One redundant pair can coexist with a healthy set. Judge the representation at set level using mean pairwise similarity, centered effective rank, semantic source-view recoverability, specialization under disagreement, and missing-view safety.
general_rule: A local redundancy statistic is diagnostic, not a universal capability gate, unless the task requires pairwise uniqueness.

trigger: Draft latent challenge initially removed relation/evidence views even where redundant structured evidence could still answer correctly.
lesson: A counterfactual removal gate is valid only when the removed channel is uniquely necessary for the tested conclusion. Redundant evidence should be allowed to preserve capability rather than being treated as a validation failure.
general_rule: Use causal ablations only where causal necessity is part of the contract; otherwise measure correctness and information preservation without forcing dependence on one implementation path.

trigger: Step 360 selected from train/dev before untouched challenge construction.
lesson: Confirmatory challenges must evaluate one preselected checkpoint. Never use the ratification set to choose among saved training checkpoints. Freeze challenge bytes, thresholds, candidate hash, evaluator, and revision before observing results.
general_rule: Separate model selection from final confirmation to avoid adaptive overfitting to the ratification set.
